name: typology
doc:
LANGUAGE TYPOLOGY / FAMILIES - comprehensive linguistics, step 5, the last of this pass
(Matt, 2026-10-10). A language's family from a curated reference, sealed through
linguistics.LING_VERIFY. Idempotent.

sticks.question: Language typology - the families of tongues

marks.claim: [a family, SEALED] English is an Indo-European language (sealed through linguistics.LING_VERIFY): Germanic -> West Germanic -> Indo-European. The family tree of tongues is the comparative method's fruit - and the home of this very floor.
[a different family, SEALED] Arabic is Semitic (Afro-Asiatic), sealed - NOT Indo-European. The families are distinct; a claim across them is a mismatch.

[curated, declines the unknown] The reference is a curated list of languages -> families; an unknown language DECLINES rather than guesses. 0 false positives: a family not in the language's chain cannot be confirmed.

[on the one map - the comprehensive-linguistics pass is COMPLETE] Typology closes this pass on the linguistics floor (card_floor_indo_european): phonology, orthography, etymology, historical sound change and the Biblical lexicon already held; morphology, transliteration, semantics, closed-class POS and typology added - with deep parsing declined as the honest offline floor. Linguistics went from a Strong's-only lane to a comprehensive domain.
